title: Operation

requestScope.$comment: serverScope + requestId is the transport deduplication key; same digest reuses the Operation and a different digest is RequestConflict.

correlationId.description: Trace identifier only; it does not grant authorization.

sourceType.description: plan: Controller-generated deterministic Operation. direct: user/API-initiated resource command.

operationKey.description: Deterministic plan item key such as environment/{uid}/intent/{gen}/plan/{planUid}/item/{itemKey}. Required for sourceType=plan, forbidden for sourceType=direct.

attempt.description: Required for sourceType=plan, forbidden for sourceType=direct.

claimRevision.description: Acceptance starts at 0; every claim and status compare-and-update fences on this value.

externalTaskRef.description: Opaque provider job/UPID; if present after restart, poll it rather than submitting again.

execData.description: Provider tracking data, not a workflow graph.

$comment: Operation is the durable fact for one technical side effect. Executor owns status/lease/result/error; targetSnapshot is mandatory and immutable. sourceType=plan uses operationKey+attempt for deterministic dedup; sourceType=direct uses transport key only. All Operations require a Resource. Unknown means unconfirmed external outcome and cannot be automatically resent.
